proposedBellaRules.singleAuthority: One class-specific concrete audio-frequency authority. Explicit OMF extension of agreed MDB source principle, adding native-proven MPGA source. No competing MDFL/summary votes, generic MDAU fallback for every class, MDFL/master/project/timecode/other-descriptor repair or guessed48kHz default for this column.
proposedBellaRules.validation: Safely owned descriptor, known property type/width and summary container/chunk framing; checked ranges/offsets/padding; positive numerator/denominator or supported positive finite exact Hz. Missing/damaged/conflicting required concrete claims, unsafe or unsupported representation gives no OMF Sample Rate, preserving inventory and other valid facts. No need for sound payload or unrelated codec-label success.
proposedBellaRules.byteOrder: PCMA/MPGA signed32 pair follows established OMF object numeric order. WAVE fmt UInt32 is little-endian; AIFF COMM extended80 is big-endian independently. No text decoder or video NTSC audio-Hz alias.
proposedBellaRules.precisionAndRetention: Preserve exact supported numeric value, original fraction/WAVE integer/necessary AIFF80 representation and compact source/type/availability. Small bounded format decoder and existing C++17/QtEndian value/comparison helpers; unsupported unrepresentable values remain unavailable, never silently narrowed/rounded. No full Summary copy, raw graph or arbitrary-precision dependency required.
proposedBellaRules.presentation: Reuse current useful late kHz labels and numeric-rate sorting, with shared exact comparison.48kHz/44.1kHz are examples, no frequency whitelist. No unnecessary permanent whole-Hz copy. Video Sample Rate and audio Frame Rate remain blank; channels do not multiply frequency. Uncommon label precision remains existing presentation follow-up.
proposedBellaRules.durationUnchanged: Accepted OMF Duration retains own MDFL Length/unit clock and bounded same-owner summary-frequency recovery only when that Duration clock is unusable, plus own audio EditRate and qualified numbering. Concrete Sample Rate selection does not replace Duration count/clock or editing/display clock. Different roles may differ without creating competing frequency votes or a consistency graph.
proposedBellaRules.readingAndPriorities: Read required metadata from already justified OMF job with bounded chunk navigation, skipping sound and unrelated payload. Native WAV/AIFF layout/general damage and final cross-source priorities/opening decisions remain separate. No new file open solely from this review.

aiff-exact-extended-decoder.note: Projection uses the raw10-byte big-endian extended value and exact power-of-two fraction where int32 numerator/denominator fit. Negative/nonfinite/zero/unrepresentable rejected.

summary-type-container-bounds.note: Requires DataValue/VarLenBytes and matching RIFF-WAVE or FORM-AIFF/AIFC signature. Bounded chunks/padding; stops at omitted data/SSND payload.

wave-wire-le.note: fmt nSamplesPerSec at offset4 uses four LE bytes, independent of OMF object byte order.

aiff-wire-be-approximation.note: COMM frequency is10 big-endian extended bytes at offset8. Reader retains bytes plus a diagnostic double approximation; projector later uses exact raw decoder.

outer-native-source.note: Outer native WAV/AIFF format has its own SampleRate observations; distinct from embedded/copy Summary owner facts.

embedded-native-merge.note: Current wrapper merges eligible embedded OMF facts only after identity qualification; native and embedded observations remain distinct origins.

numeric-equality.note: SampleRate equality recognizes mathematically equal unreduced positive fractions.

same-rank-conflict.note: Same-source-rank differing present values tie and clear selected value; no special MDFL-versus-Summary preference.

sample-rate-source-policy.note: Current headers outrank MDB; no owner/property preference within OMF. Final Bella priorities separate.

row-ratio-and-compat-int.note: Exact selected fraction retained; separate whole-Hz compatibility integer rounded. Display normally prefers exact ratio.

table-numeric-role.note: SampleRate numeric role uses sampleRateHz, not parsed label.

numeric-sort.note: Sort compares sampleRateHz numeric values; does not reparse kHz label.

"""Known-example metadata-only OMF audio frequency probe, not Bella code.

Reads the two already qualified live tone files' own short Summary metadata.
No native outer audio chunk or recording-data payload is requested.
"""
from pathlib import Path
from fractions import Fraction
import hashlib
import json
import struct

SOURCE = Path('/private/tmp/bella-omf-duration-observed-20261024/findings.json')
previous = json.loads(SOURCE.read_text())
DEST = Path('/private/tmp/bella-omf-audio-sample-rate-observed-20261024')
DEST.mkdir(exist_ok=True)

def extended80(raw):
    assert len(raw) == 10
    word = int.from_bytes(raw[:2], 'big')
    exponent = word & 0x7fff
    significand = int.from_bytes(raw[2:], 'big')
    assert not word & 0x8000 and exponent not in (0, 0x7fff)
    assert significand & (1 << 63)  # Known positive normal examples only.
    power = exponent - 16383 - 63
    return Fraction(significand << power, 1) if power >= 0 else Fraction(significand, 1 << -power)

rows = []
for old in previous['files']:
    if not old['path'].endswith(('.wav', '.aif')):
        continue
    path = Path(old['path'])
    context = old['physicalOwnerTiming'][0]
    owner = context['fileOwner']['object']
    descriptor = context['fileOwner']['descriptor']
    before = path.stat()
    reads = []
    with path.open('rb') as stream:
        def read_at(offset, count):
            assert 0 <= offset <= before.st_size
            assert 0 <= count <= before.st_size - offset
            stream.seek(offset)
            raw = stream.read(count)
            assert len(raw) == count
            reads.append({'offset': offset, 'bytes': count,
                          'sha256': hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()})
            return raw

        label_offset = before.st_size - 24
        assert label_offset == old['labelOffset']
        label = read_at(label_offset, 24)
        assert label[:8] == bytes.fromhex('a4434da5486472d7')
        assert struct.unpack('<HH', label[12:16]) == (1, 0)
        toc_offset, toc_bytes = struct.unpack('<II', label[16:24])
        assert (toc_offset, toc_bytes) == (old['tocOffset'], old['tocBytes'])
        assert 0 < toc_bytes < 2*1024*1024 and toc_bytes % 24 == 0
        assert toc_offset + toc_bytes <= label_offset
        toc = read_at(toc_offset, toc_bytes)
        assert hashlib.sha256(toc).hexdigest() == old['tocSha256']
        entries = []
        for pos in range(0, len(toc), 24):
            obj, prop, typ, location, length, generation, flags = struct.unpack('<IIIIIHH', toc[pos:pos+24])
            assert not flags & ~3
            offset = toc_offset + pos + 12 if flags & 1 else location
            structural = obj == 1 and typ == 19 and prop in (4, 5, 7)
            limit = before.st_size if structural or flags & 1 else toc_offset
            assert 0 <= offset <= limit and length <= limit - offset
            assert not flags & 1 or length <= 4
            entries.append({'object': obj, 'property': prop, 'type': typ,
                            'offset': offset, 'length': length,
                            'generation': generation, 'flags': flags})

        def small(entry):
            assert not entry['flags'] & 2 and entry['length'] <= 512
            if entry['flags'] & 1:
                pos = entry['offset'] - toc_offset
                return toc[pos:pos+entry['length']]
            return read_at(entry['offset'], entry['length'])

        names = {}
        for entry in entries:
            if entry['property'] in (23, 24):
                names[entry['object']] = small(entry).split(b'\0')[0].decode('ascii')
        def named(obj, name):
            matches = [e for e in entries if e['object'] == obj and names.get(e['property']) == name]
            assert matches, (obj, name)
            if len(matches) > 1:
                assert len({(e['type'], e['length'], e['generation'], e['flags']) for e in matches}) == 1
                assert len({small(e) for e in matches}) == 1
            e = matches[0]
            return {**e, 'propertyName': name, 'typeName': names.get(e['type'], ''),
                    'equalRepeatedEntries': matches if len(matches) > 1 else []}

        checked_context = []
        for obj, name in [(1, 'OMFI:ByteOrder'), (owner, 'OMFI:MOBJ:MobID'),
                          (owner, 'OMFI:MOBJ:PhysicalMedia'), (descriptor, 'OMFI:ObjID'),
                          (descriptor, 'OMFI:MDFL:SampleRate')]:
            e = named(obj, name)
            value = small(e)
            expected = next(p for p in old['selectedSmallRawProperties']
                            if p['object'] == obj and p['propertyName'] == name)
            assert value.hex() == expected['hex']
            checked_context.append({**e, 'hex': value.hex()})
        tag = next(p for p in checked_context if p['propertyName'] == 'OMFI:ObjID')['hex']
        descriptor_class = bytes.fromhex(tag).decode('ascii')
        assert descriptor_class in ('WAVD', 'AIFD')
        summary_name = 'OMFI:WAVD:Summary' if descriptor_class == 'WAVD' else 'OMFI:AIFD:Summary'
        summary = named(descriptor, summary_name)
        assert summary['typeName'] in ('omfi:DataValue', 'omfi:VarLenBytes')
        assert not summary['flags'] & 3 and summary['length'] >= 12
        start, size = summary['offset'], summary['length']
        def summary_read(relative, count):
            assert 0 <= relative <= size and 0 <= count <= size - relative
            return read_at(start + relative, count)

        header = summary_read(0, 12)
        wave = descriptor_class == 'WAVD'
        assert (header[:4] == b'RIFF' and header[8:12] == b'WAVE') if wave else (
            header[:4] == b'FORM' and header[8:12] in (b'AIFF', b'AIFC'))
        numeric_order = 'little' if wave else 'big'
        chunks = []
        position = 12
        selected = None
        for _ in range(128):  # Known-example probe guard, not Bella policy.
            assert position + 8 <= size
            chunk_header = summary_read(position, 8)
            key = chunk_header[:4]
            declared = int.from_bytes(chunk_header[4:], numeric_order)
            chunks.append({'relativeOffset': position, 'keyHex': key.hex(),
                           'declaredBytes': declared, 'headerHex': chunk_header.hex()})
            wanted = key == (b'fmt ' if wave else b'COMM')
            if wanted:
                required = 16 if wave else 18
                assert declared >= required and required <= size - position - 8
                prefix = summary_read(position + 8, required)
                frequency = prefix[4:8] if wave else prefix[8:18]
                rate = Fraction(int.from_bytes(frequency, 'little'), 1) if wave else extended80(frequency)
                assert rate == 48000
                selected = {'chunk': key.decode('ascii'), 'chunkRelativeOffset': position,
                            'declaredChunkBytes': declared, 'requiredPrefixHex': prefix.hex(),
                            'frequencyOffset': start + position + 8 + (4 if wave else 8),
                            'frequencyBytes': len(frequency), 'frequencyHex': frequency.hex(),
                            'frequencyEncoding': 'UInt32LE' if wave else 'extended80BE',
                            'exactFrequencyHz': [rate.numerator, rate.denominator],
                            'illustrativeLabelNotAppOutput': '48 kHz'}
                break
            # Do not enter sample-data chunks, even if the property is a summary.
            assert key not in (b'data', b'SSND')
            assert declared <= size - position - 8
            position += 8 + declared + (declared & 1)
        assert selected is not None

    after = path.stat()
    assert (before.st_size, before.st_mtime_ns, before.st_ino) == (after.st_size, after.st_mtime_ns, after.st_ino)
    rows.append({'path': str(path), 'fileBytes': before.st_size, 'mtimeNs': before.st_mtime_ns,
                 'inode': before.st_ino, 'stableImmediate': True,
                 'container': 'Bento1.0/legacyOMF1', 'metadataNumericByteOrder': 'II',
                 'labelOffset': label_offset, 'tocOffset': toc_offset, 'tocBytes': toc_bytes,
                 'tocSha256': hashlib.sha256(toc).hexdigest(),
                 'agreesWithPriorTocAndSelectedContext': True,
                 'fullFileMobId': context['physicalMedia']['fileMobId'],
                 'fileOwnerObject': owner, 'descriptorObject': descriptor,
                 'descriptorClass': descriptor_class, 'freshContextValues': checked_context,
                 'summaryProperty': summary, 'summaryHeaderHex': header.hex(),
                 'chunkHeadersTraversed': chunks, 'selectedFrequency': selected,
                 'reads': reads, 'logicalBytesReturned': sum(r['bytes'] for r in reads)})

assert len(rows) == 2
out = {'date': '2026-10-24', 'timezone': 'Australia/Sydney',
       'scope': 'Two known live OMF-era WAVE/AIFF-C tone paths; own Summary frequency only, with fresh identical TOC/ID/class/reference context. No outer native chunk/sample payload, production parser/app/test or benchmark.',
       'script': {'path': __file__, 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest()},
       'priorOwnerTimingContext': {'path': str(SOURCE), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(SOURCE.read_bytes()).hexdigest()},
       'files': rows,
       'limits': ['Known Bento1/II examples only; summary internal numeric order remains WAVE little/AIFF big.',
                  'An initial probe attempt stopped at equal repeated MobID entries before reading frequency. The successful pass explicitly verifies equal repeated typed values; its read totals are not the full turn I/O.',
                  'Stops at the selected matching format chunk; not arbitrary repeated/conflicting/malformed-summary validation.',
                  'No PCMA/MPGA, non48kHz/fractional/missing/damaged/legacy opposite-order coverage.',
                  'Probe guard and no-continuation assumptions are research limits, not Bella parser limits.',
                  'Labels are arithmetic illustrations, not observed app output.']}
(DEST/'findings.json').write_text(json.dumps(out, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'files': [{'Filename': Path(f['path']).name,
                            'class': f['descriptorClass'],
                            'summaryOffset': f['summaryProperty']['offset'],
                            'summaryBytes': f['summaryProperty']['length'],
                            **f['selectedFrequency']} for f in rows],
                  'logicalBytesReturned': sum(f['logicalBytesReturned'] for f in rows)}, indent=2))

"""Curate OMF audio Sample Rate research; no media or runtime operations."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess

ROOT = Path('/Users/martymclean/Developer/MediaMuster')

def sha(path):
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with Path(path).open('rb') as stream:
        for block in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024*1024), b''):
            h.update(block)
    return h.hexdigest()

def record(path):
    path = Path(path)
    return {'path': str(path), 'bytes': path.stat().st_size, 'sha256': sha(path)}

receipts, receipt_files, verified, captures = {}, {}, {}, {}
unavailable = []

def check(path, expected, context):
    p = Path(path)
    if not p.is_absolute():
        p = ROOT/p
    if not p.is_file():
        unavailable.append({'path': str(p), 'expectedSha256': expected, 'context': context})
        return
    actual = sha(p)
    assert actual == expected, (str(p), expected, actual)
    verified[str(p)] = {'sha256': actual, 'bytes': p.stat().st_size}
    if str(p).startswith('/private/tmp/') and p.suffix == '.txt' and p.stat().st_size <= 200000:
        captures[str(p)] = {'sha256': actual, 'text': p.read_text()}

def walk(value, context):
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        for pk, hk in [('path', 'sha256'), ('artifact', 'artifactSha256'),
                       ('resolvedArtifact', 'resolvedArtifactSha256')]:
            if isinstance(value.get(pk), str) and isinstance(value.get(hk), str):
                check(value[pk], value[hk], context)
        for key, child in value.items():
            walk(child, context+'/'+str(key))
    elif isinstance(value, list):
        for index, child in enumerate(value):
            walk(child, context+'/'+str(index))

for who in ['mc', 'mdvx', 'current']:
    path = Path('/private/tmp/bella-omf-audio-sample-rate-'+who+'-20261024/findings.json')
    receipts[who] = json.loads(path.read_text())
    receipt_files[who] = record(path)
    walk(receipts[who], who)

current = receipts['current']
for relative, expected in current['sourceHashesSha256'].items():
    path = ROOT/relative
    check(str(path), expected, 'current/sourceHashesSha256')
    assert subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', 'HEAD:'+relative], cwd=ROOT) == path.read_bytes()
for anchor in current['anchors'].values():
    lines = (ROOT/anchor['path']).read_text().splitlines(keepends=True)
    excerpt = ''.join(lines[anchor['startLine']-1:anchor['endLine']]).encode()
    assert hashlib.sha256(excerpt).hexdigest() == anchor['excerptSha256'], anchor

range_checks, slot_checks, constant_checks = [], [], []
mdvx = receipts['mdvx']
with Path(mdvx['binary']['path']).open('rb') as stream:
    for method in mdvx['freshFunctions']+mdvx['reusedFunctions']:
        stream.seek(method['binaryOffset'])
        raw = stream.read(method['codeBytes'])
        assert len(raw) == method['codeBytes']
        assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == method['codeSha256']
        range_checks.append({'symbol': method['symbol'], 'binaryOffset': method['binaryOffset'],
                             'bytes': len(raw), 'sha256': method['codeSha256']})
    for value in mdvx['compiledDictionary'].get('doubleConstants', []):
        stream.seek(value['fileOffset'])
        assert stream.read(value['bytes']).hex() == value['rawHex']
        constant_checks.append(value)
for block in receipts['mc']['rawSlotsDecoded']:
    with Path(block['binary']).open('rb') as stream:
        for slot in block['slots']:
            stream.seek(slot['fileOffset'])
            assert stream.read(8).hex() == slot['rawHex']
            slot_checks.append(slot)
assert len(slot_checks) == 8

observed_path = Path('/private/tmp/bella-omf-audio-sample-rate-observed-20261024/findings.json')
observed = json.loads(observed_path.read_text())
walk(observed, 'observed')
assert len(observed['files']) == 2
assert {f['descriptorClass'] for f in observed['files']} == {'WAVD', 'AIFD'}
assert all(f['stableImmediate'] and f['agreesWithPriorTocAndSelectedContext'] for f in observed['files'])
assert all(f['selectedFrequency']['exactFrequencyHz'] == [48000, 1] for f in observed['files'])
assert all(f['metadataNumericByteOrder'] == 'II' for f in observed['files'])
assert sum(f['logicalBytesReturned'] for f in observed['files']) == 22141
probe_path = Path(observed['script']['path'])
assert sha(probe_path) == observed['script']['sha256']

approvals = {}
for kind in ['frame-rate', 'duration']:
    path = ROOT/f'Project Bella/evidence/omf-{kind}-plan-2026-10-24.json'
    value = json.loads(path.read_text())
    research = value['researchAtApproval']
    assert sha(research['path']) == research['sha256']
    approvals[kind] = record(path)

historical = [v for v in unavailable if v['context'].startswith('mc/reusedArtifactBoundary/')]
fresh_unavailable = [v for v in unavailable if v not in historical]
assert not fresh_unavailable, fresh_unavailable

rules = {
    'scope': 'OMF audio Sample Rate column proposal only; Frame Rate accepted. No runtime implementation/cutover, Bin Filter change, final source-priority table or new header-opening reason. MDB Kind/class scope unchanged.',
    'concreteClassSources': {'PCMA': 'Own OMFI:PCMA:AudioSamplingRate, known eight-byte ExactEditRate.',
                             'MPGA': 'Own OMFI:MDAU:AudioSamplingRate, known eight-byte ExactEditRate.',
                             'AIFD': 'Own OMFI:AIFD:Summary COMM sampleRate, ten-byte extended80BE.',
                             'WAVD': 'Own OMFI:WAVD:Summary fmt nSamplesPerSec, unsigned32LE Hz.',
                             'contextualWAVE': 'Existing accepted qualified WAVE descriptor compatibility only through its own supported WAVD Summary; not a root WAVE MediaData shortcut or new native descriptor proof.'},
    'singleAuthority': 'One class-specific concrete audio-frequency authority. Explicit OMF extension of agreed MDB source principle, adding native-proven MPGA source. No competing MDFL/summary votes, generic MDAU fallback for every class, MDFL/master/project/timecode/other-descriptor repair or guessed48kHz default for this column.',
    'validation': 'Safely owned descriptor, known property type/width and summary container/chunk framing; checked ranges/offsets/padding; positive numerator/denominator or supported positive finite exact Hz. Missing/damaged/conflicting required concrete claims, unsafe or unsupported representation gives no OMF Sample Rate, preserving inventory and other valid facts. No need for sound payload or unrelated codec-label success.',
    'byteOrder': 'PCMA/MPGA signed32 pair follows established OMF object numeric order. WAVE fmt UInt32 is little-endian; AIFF COMM extended80 is big-endian independently. No text decoder or video NTSC audio-Hz alias.',
    'precisionAndRetention': 'Preserve exact supported numeric value, original fraction/WAVE integer/necessary AIFF80 representation and compact source/type/availability. Small bounded format decoder and existing C++17/QtEndian value/comparison helpers; unsupported unrepresentable values remain unavailable, never silently narrowed/rounded. No full Summary copy, raw graph or arbitrary-precision dependency required.',
    'presentation': 'Reuse current useful late kHz labels and numeric-rate sorting, with shared exact comparison.48kHz/44.1kHz are examples, no frequency whitelist. No unnecessary permanent whole-Hz copy. Video Sample Rate and audio Frame Rate remain blank; channels do not multiply frequency. Uncommon label precision remains existing presentation follow-up.',
    'durationUnchanged': 'Accepted OMF Duration retains own MDFL Length/unit clock and bounded same-owner summary-frequency recovery only when that Duration clock is unusable, plus own audio EditRate and qualified numbering. Concrete Sample Rate selection does not replace Duration count/clock or editing/display clock. Different roles may differ without creating competing frequency votes or a consistency graph.',
    'readingAndPriorities': 'Read required metadata from already justified OMF job with bounded chunk navigation, skipping sound and unrelated payload. Native WAV/AIFF layout/general damage and final cross-source priorities/opening decisions remain separate. No new file open solely from this review.'
